name: PlentyONE (plentymarkets)
description: Access PlentyONE (formerly plentymarkets), the German multi-channel e-commerce ERP: orders, variations, stock levels, warehouses, customer contacts and order status updates via the REST API.
instructions:
**PlentyONE (formerly plentymarkets) is a German multi-channel e-commerce ERP.** It manages orders, items and variations, stock levels across multiple warehouses, and customer contacts across marketplaces like Amazon, eBay, Otto and webshops.

**Authentication via LOGIN_TOKEN:** PlentyONE uses short-lived JWT tokens (86,400s / 24h). This adapter uses the `LOGIN_TOKEN` flow: it POSTs `{username, password}` to `{{PLENTY_URL}}/rest/login`, extracts the returned `access_token`, sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, and refreshes it proactively (every 3600s and automatically upon receiving an HTTP 401). You never handle raw tokens manually.

**Setup and Credentials:**
- `PLENTY_URL`: The root URL of your PlentyONE system (e.g. `https://p12345.my.plentysystems.com`, no trailing slash). You can locate this in the PlentyONE backend under *Setup → Settings → API → Data*.
- `PLENTY_USERNAME`: REST API user username.
- `PLENTY_PASSWORD`: REST API user password.

**Best Practices:** We recommend creating a dedicated REST user account with least-privilege permissions under *Setup → Settings → User → Accounts*. Note that each active REST user counts against the concurrent API user limit (typically 3 users on standard plans; receiving HTTP 429 indicates concurrency exhaustion).

**Rate Limits:** PlentyONE enforces rate limits based on system edition (Basic edition: 80 read calls/minute, 40 write calls/minute). Agents should stagger batch requests.

**Item vs Variation vs Stock:** In PlentyONE, catalog items are containers holding one or more variations (`/items/variations`). Inventory availability is tracked per variation per warehouse (`/stockmanagement/stock`). To query physical stock, retrieve the `variationId` first, then call `plentymarkets_list_stock`.

**Order Status Management:** Orders progress through numeric status codes (e.g., 5.0 for cleared for shipping). The status update tool `plentymarkets_update_order_status` executes a destructive write operation and is installed switched off (`enabled: false`) by default. Enable it explicitly when automated order transitions are required.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_warehouses
tools.description: List all fulfillment and storage warehouses configured in the PlentyONE system with their identifier, name, and warehouse type. Ideal for connectivity testing.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_orders
tools.description: Query sales orders in PlentyONE filtered by status range, creation timestamp window, customer contact identifier, or included relations.

statusFrom.description: Filter orders starting from this numeric status ID (e.g. 1.0 for unpaid, 5.0 for cleared for shipping).

statusTo.description: Filter orders up to this numeric status ID (e.g. 5.9 for in-picking/in-packing).

createdAtFrom.description: Earliest order creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00+02:00).

createdAtTo.description: Latest order creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2026-10-31T23:59:59+02:00).

contactId.description: Filter orders placed by a specific customer contact ID.

with.description: Additional sub-resources to embed in order results, such as 'orderItems' or 'addresses'.

page.description: Page index of paginated order results to retrieve (default is 1).

itemsPerPage.description: Maximum number of order records to return per page (maximum is 100).

tools.name: plentymarkets_get_order
tools.description: Retrieve full details of a specific PlentyONE sales order by ID, including order items, totals, billing/shipping addresses, and current status.

orderId.description: The unique numerical identifier of the PlentyONE order.

with.description: Optional related data arrays to include, such as 'orderItems', 'addresses', or 'comments'.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_variations
tools.description: Search item variations in the PlentyONE product catalog by exact item number, name, barcode/EAN, or active availability status.

numberExact.description: Search for variations matching this exact variation SKU or number.

itemName.description: Search for variations by partial or complete product item name.

barcode.description: Search for variations matching an exact barcode or EAN code.

isActive.description: Filter by active status (true for active variations, false for inactive).

page.description: Page index for paginated catalog variation search results (default is 1).

itemsPerPage.description: Number of catalog variation records to return per page (maximum is 100).

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_stock
tools.description: Inspect stock and inventory levels across PlentyONE warehouses for a specific product variation or warehouse identifier.

variationId.description: The numerical identifier of the item variation to inspect inventory for.

warehouseId.description: Filter inventory quantities to this specific storage or fulfillment warehouse ID.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_contacts
tools.description: Search customer and business partner contacts in PlentyONE by email address or free-text query across name, company, and address fields.

email.description: Exact or prefix email address of the customer contact to find.

fullText.description: Free-text search query across contact names, company names, and customer numbers.

page.description: Page index for paginated contact records (default is 1).

itemsPerPage.description: Number of customer contact records to return per page (maximum is 100).

tools.name: plentymarkets_get_contact
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive contact profile information for a specific customer or merchant contact record in PlentyONE by ID.

contactId.description: The unique numerical identifier of the customer contact to retrieve.

tools.name: plentymarkets_update_order_status
tools.description: Update the workflow status of an existing PlentyONE order. Write operation disabled by default to require explicit enablement.

orderId.description: The unique numerical identifier of the PlentyONE order to update.

statusId.description: The new numeric workflow status code to set (e.g. 5.0 for cleared for shipping, 7.0 for finished).
